title: REQUEST: Wear OS app for use xDrip on my 5y.o. child smartwatch for using without smartphone
body:
Hello!
My 5 y.o. daughter has diabetes type 1 and goes to kindergarten.
She is too young to take smartphone with. And it's too dificult.
Standalone app runs on android 4.4 or higher.
I cant find to buy any children smartwatch with android 4.4...
Can you make stand alone application for Wear OS to collect data via bluetooth an send to followers?

comments.body:
xDrip+ supports wear integration through its wear app. The xDrip+ wear app is installed with the standard xDrip+ apk. For details see [here](https://github.com/jamorham/xDrip-plus/blob/master/Documentation/WatchGuide.md).
There is a watch on Wear OS which works as a collector at a long distance from the phone. For example, my daugther goes to school and wears Dexcom G5 & Huawei Watch 2 LTE. At the same time the paired phone is at home. The xDrip+ on the phone shows her current BG readings, uploads them to Nightscout and sends them to xDrip+ follower. Also you can use a full Android watch instead of Wear OS watches, e.g. Finow Q1 Pro.

It is great information! Thank you!
But Huawei Watch 2 LTE does not look like a watch for a baby... I will try anyway, of course. 
Can you specify common parameters to help me find more siutable watch for my little daughter?
For example: embedded slot for SIM-card, Wear OS, bluetoth 4.0, ability to install app from unknown sources, etc...

I think that it is better to go with a phone and put the phone near the kid.
If that is not possible, then there are watches that have full android.
For example the "Finow Q1 Pro" works well with xdrip and miaomiao (you need to verify that for the g5).
Still it would look huge on a 5 years old boy, although you can put it in his pocket.
You might look at a mini Android phone, like a Unihertz Jelly Pro. It is only slightly larger than a watch, can easily be kept in a child's pocket, and has cellular connectivity for following.

NStrakhov, as you can see there are many solutions for your case. But if you will intend to use the watch mentioned me, I mean the "Huawei Watch 2 LTE", then make sure before your buying that it has build number: OWDE.180215.017. For details see [here](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Patching-Android-Wear-devices-for-use-with-the-G5).
In addition you can read about my experience using this watch clicking [this link](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/744).
About using "Finow Q1 Pro" look at [here](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/648).
And certainly you can find more usefull information using Search Box on the Issues page and [gitter](https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus).

Hi, I have huawei watch 2, build OWDE.180926.001.A1, is there any solution to set it as collector. 
tnx

You can try to find the required ROM and flash it on your watcn, then patch your watch. Search [here](
https://forum.xda-developers.com/).
Tnx you so mouch. Finishes successfully.

Just I get the 
ERROR with demigod mode
ERROR with demigod-2 mode

Is that some problem

For now, working as collector
There is no guarantee that the watch will work as required. The status of these modes should be OK.

Right now it is ok, will see in future.
Tnx

I had to downgrade from OWDE.180926.001.A1 to the exact version mentioned in patch instructions (OWDE.180215.017). Then patches do apply correctly.

I requested @jamorham if he could make the patches against OWDE.180926.001.A1 as well, it would be much obliged.
